strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated Persian ی as one uninterrupted dotless S-shaped run: begin at the upper right, sweep left into the upper curve, descend through the central turn, then continue around the below-baseline bowl to its rising tip without lifting. Initial and medial forms use a joined be-series tooth rather than this broad independent body. The learner path fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and keeps Persian-scoped provenance separate from the independently verified Urdu ی record.
